title: A chapter ends
paragraphs: Four years is a long time to believe in something. I thought I was building a life with someone. Now it has ended, and I am left with the feeling that so much of my time, care and effort went somewhere I can no longer reach.

I gave a lot to these years. Looking back, it is painful to feel that it may all have been for nothing. The hardest part is not only losing someone. It is realizing how quickly trust can break, and how easily another person can make you question the feelings you once gave without hesitation.
Love can be generous, but it can also be cruel. Sometimes it leaves you with more questions than memories, and with the strange regret of having been sincere.
I'm writing this from Bangkok, at the beginning of a different chapter. I don't know what comes next. For now, I am letting this be an ending.
